input.title: Q4 launch sync
input.attendees: Dana Whitfield, Marco Reyes, Priya Nair
input.transcript:
Dana: Quick sync on the Q4 launch. We have budget approved at 12000 dollars and the release is set for 2026-12-03.
Marco: The pricing page still shows the old price. Priya, can you update it by Friday?
Priya: Sure. I'll also send the new screenshots to the design team tomorrow.
Dana: We decided to go with the annual plan as the default offer.
Marco: I will draft the announcement email by next week.
Dana: Great, thanks everyone.
